In the Office365 calendar flow, the caller merges this parsed data into the stored key, so it overwrites the real refresh token with the literal string; disabling sync, a sync outage/fallback, or later migration back to provider refresh makes the credential permanently unrefreshable. adjudication.rationale: The finding correctly identifies that parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts lines 24-26 set `refreshTokenResponse.data.refresh_token = "refresh_token"` (a literal string) when no refresh_token is present. In office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts:264, the code does `o365AuthCredentials = { ...o365AuthCredentials, ...(tokenResponse.success && tokenResponse.data) }`, which spreads the parsed data (including the fabricated "refresh_token" string) over the existing credentials. This would overwrite the real refresh_token with the literal string "refresh_token", making future token refreshes fail. This is a real bug in the credential sync flow.
